predecessors.name: Sultanate of Rum
predecessors.text: the province of Eflani (Eflani, Safranbolu, Karabük), 'awarded' to Şemseddin Yaman Candar under Seljuk authority

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Kastamonu, Sinop, Çankırı and the Black Sea coast, incorporated into the Ottoman Empire in 1461

ledger.x: 1291: Şemseddin Yaman Candar Bey founds the Candar principality at Eflani.
1309: Süleyman I takes Kastamonu from the Chobanids.
1309: the Candar seat moves from Eflani to Kastamonu.
1309: Süleyman I rules Kastamonu under Ilkhanid authority.
1322: the Candars annex Sinop from the Pervâneids.
30 November 1335: the Ilkhanid authority ends with Abu Said.
1344: Cliopatria adds about 30 cells (8,300 km2) in the south, round Çankırı and Tosya, to the Candar shape.
1391: İsfendiyar, left at Sinop, becomes an Ottoman vassal.
1402: Timur confirms İsfendiyar in Kastamonu, Kalecik, Tosya and Çankırı.
1402: the Ottoman suzerainty ends with the defeat at Ankara.
1403 (a bridge over a silence): Timur leaves Anatolia.
By 1421: Çankırı and Tosya are Ottoman.
1422 (a bridge inside 1421-1423): İsfendiyar retakes the lobe.
1461: Mehmed II takes Sinop and ends the Candar dynasty.
1461: the Candar principality is incorporated into the Ottoman Empire.

wars.name: Bayezid I's assault on Kastamonu
wars.outcome: Süleyman II dies and the Candar reign in Kastamonu ends; İsfendiyar, at Sinop, accepts Bayezid's suzerainty as a vassal.

wars.name: Battle of Ankara and the Timurid confirmation of İsfendiyar
wars.outcome: Timur defeats Bayezid I and confirms İsfendiyar's rule in Kastamonu, Kalecik, Tosya and Çankırı.

wars.name: İsfendiyar's revolt against Murad II and the Battle of Bolu
wars.outcome: While Murad II was occupied with Mustafa Çelebi (accession 1421, execution 20 February 1423), İsfendiyar took Tosya, Çankırı and Kalecik from the Ottomans (Battle of Bolu page); in 1423 Murad II defeated the Candar army at Bolu, near Safranbolu, where Kasım…

wars.name: Mehmed II's conquest of Sinop and the Candar principality
wars.outcome: Mehmed II, with İsmail's brother Kızıl Ahmed Bey, captures Sinop and ends the Candar dynasty in the summer campaign of 1461; the principality is incorporated into the Ottoman Empire.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a treaty line or survey; the Black Sea, Çankırı and Bolu frontiers are approximate throughout.
